section.content: 本发明提供一种半导体集成电路，该电路不增大电路规模而能提高脉冲波形生成中的波形生成自由度，而且即使是周期调制动作，CPU的处理负荷也轻，响应速度也不变慢。该电路具有：存储设定空载时间用的值的空载时间设定寄存器17；存储设定脉冲宽度用的值的脉宽设定寄存器20；将上述设定空载时间用的值与上述设定脉宽用的值相加并输出相加值的加法器19；将经过时间加以计数并输出表示经过时间的计数值的定时计数器12；将定时计数器12输出的计数值与加法器19输出的所述相加值作比较的比较电路15；以及根据比较电路的比较结果生成脉冲波形的波形生成电路26。

The invention provides a semiconductor integrated circuit which can increase the wave shape generation freedom during the generation of pulse wave shape without increasing the scale of the circuit, with slight processing load of CPU and quick response speed even during a period modulation action. The circuit comprises an idle-load time setting memory 17 for storing the valve for setting the idle-load time; a pulse width setting memory 20 for storing the value for setting the pulse width; a summator 19 for summarizing the value for setting the idle-load time and the value for setting the pulse width, and outputting the summarized value; a time counter 12 for counting through time and outputting the counted value; a comparing circuit 15 for comparing the counted value output by the time counter 12 with the summarized value output by the summator 19; and a wave shape generating circuit 26 for generating the pulse wave shape according to the comparing result of the comparing circuit.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit, particularly have the waveform generating circuit device of the impulse waveform systematic function that can change idle time and duty cycle.

Background technology

Following with reference to Figure 12,13 and Figure 14 explanation waveform generating circuit device in the past.

Figure 12 illustrates the block diagram of waveform generating circuit device in the past.

Waveform generating circuit device shown in Figure 12 (example 1 before) has the function of additional idle time.This waveform generating circuit device usefulness counter idle time 101 is measured idle time, generates waveform.

In described waveform generating circuit device, the sequential chart when generating the waveform that arranged idle time as shown in figure 13.

At first, make idle time counter 101 and the timer of timer conter 102 start together.After this, since idle time counter 101 timing value be stored in the consistent of the value of relatively using register 103 idle time, pulse 1 rising as shown in figure 13.Meanwhile, idle time counter 101 dwell times counting.Then, when timer conter 102 and peak pulse duration with register 104 when consistent, just decline of pulse 1.Meanwhile, make counter 101 startups idle time.

Then, because idle time, counter 101 timing value relatively used the value of register 103 consistent with being stored in idle time, as shown in figure 13, make pulse 2 risings.After pulse 2 was risen, idle time, counter 101 stopped counting once more.After this and since timer conter 102 with relatively use idle time register 103 consistent, make pulse 2 declines.Meanwhile, make idle time counter 101 and the timer of timer conter 102 start together.Repeat above action.

Yet, must have two counters in the waveform generating circuit device in the past.And make the cycle identical and when generating impulse waveform more than 2 kinds, and the degree of freedom that does not have waveform to generate, impulse waveform is fixed.In the time will obtaining the degree of freedom of Waveform Control, idle time counter 101, idle time, control circuit 105 and comparison circuit 106 became the special circuit of setting usefulness idle time.Waveform generating circuit device shown in the image pattern 14 (example 2 before) is such, makes that like this circuit scale has increased.

In addition, for example consider that duty cycle is fixed as 50% and makes the situation that continuously changes the periodic modulation waveform.As shown in Figure 8, when the change cycle, must be at every turn in the described waveform generating circuit device in the past calculate pulsewidth and be set in the pulsewidth set-up register 107 with CPU.Problem in this case is that the processing load of CPU increases the weight of, by low-response in the periodic modulation action of high speed timer conter generation.

Therefore, the present invention does in view of the above problems, its purpose is to provide the degree of freedom that does not increase circuit scale and can improve waveform generation in the impulse waveform generation, and alleviates the processing load of CPU, the semiconductor integrated circuit that response speed is not slack-off yet in the periodic modulation action.

For achieving the above object, semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention is characterised in that to possess:

The 1st memory circuit of value idle time is set in storage; The 2nd memory circuit of pulse width values is set in storage; With the described pulse width values of described setting value idle time of described the 1st memory circuit output and described the 2nd memory circuit output mutually adduction export the add circuit of additive value; Counted and export the timer conter of the count value in described elapsed time of expression the elapsed time; The 1st comparison circuit that the described additive value that the described count value of described timer conter output and described adder are exported is made comparisons; Waveform generating circuit according to the comparative result production burst waveform of described the 1st comparison circuit.
